Prepress geometry to preflight to print PDF flow

nodes.label: Dynamic CorelDRAW Property Bar (#corelPropertyBar)
nodes.rationale: One bar swaps between document info (#propBarDocInfo) and object controls (#propBarObjControls) depending on selection, mirroring CorelDRAW's context-sensitive property bar.

nodes.label: Document Sheet with Bleed, Trim and Safe-Zone Frames
nodes.norm_label: document sheet with bleed, trim and safe-zone frames
nodes.rationale: Three nested frames encode prepress geometry: dashed red bleed (+2 mm), solid trim line, dashed green safe margin (-3 mm); only the trim box defines the page origin.

nodes.label: Object Inspector Docker (text / shape / image panels)
nodes.norm_label: object inspector docker (text / shape / image panels)
nodes.rationale: Inspector shows one of three panels based on object type, and exposes print-specific affordances such as 'stretch background to bleed' and 'fill background with bleed'.

nodes.label: Millimetre Ruler System with Cursor and Object Markers
nodes.norm_label: millimetre ruler system with cursor and object markers
nodes.rationale: Ruler origin (0,0) is aligned to the top-left corner of the trim line, and rulers additionally show cursor position and selected-object extents.

nodes.label: Active Object Selection Box with CorelDRAW Handles
nodes.norm_label: active object selection box with coreldraw handles
nodes.rationale: Four corner handles plus a rotate stem emulate CorelDRAW transform handles instead of a generic outline.

nodes.label: Business-Card Template Gallery Drawer with Contact Auto-Fill
nodes.norm_label: business-card template gallery drawer with contact auto-fill
nodes.rationale: Company/person/phone fields are injected into every template at once (#tplAutoCompany/#tplAutoPerson/#tplAutoPhone) instead of requiring edits per template.

nodes.label: Left Tool Palette (pick, text, image, rect, circle, line, QR)
nodes.norm_label: left tool palette (pick, text, image, rect, circle, line, qr)
nodes.rationale: Tools are exposed as data-tool buttons with CorelDRAW keyboard hints (Space, F6, F7, F8) to match the reference editor.

nodes.label: Google Fonts: Inter, Montserrat, Playfair Display, Roboto Mono
nodes.norm_label: google fonts: inter, montserrat, playfair display, roboto mono

nodes.label: Online Print Product Constructor (CorelDRAW-style)
nodes.rationale: The product positions itself as an online constructor for printed goods that reproduces the CorelDRAW workspace metaphor rather than a generic drag-and-drop editor.

nodes.label: opentype.js 1.3.4 (CDN)
nodes.rationale: Font parsing library used for glyph/curve work needed when text must become outlines for PDF.

nodes.label: Shared State with Undo/Redo History and Toasts
nodes.norm_label: shared state with undo/redo history and toasts

nodes.label: Module Structure (css/, js/ split)
nodes.rationale: Front-end is split by responsibility: config, templates, state, pricing, preflight, canvas, mockup, pdf, ui, main.

nodes.label: REGLET Studio README
nodes.rationale: Documentation entry point describing an online print-product constructor in CorelDRAW style.

nodes.label: CDN-Hosted Dependencies Require Internet
nodes.rationale: Fonts, Tailwind and opentype.js are loaded from CDNs, so the app needs internet access and has no offline path.

nodes.label: Order and Price Docker (product, size, material, sides, finishing, qty)
nodes.norm_label: order and price docker (product, size, material, sides, finishing, qty)
nodes.rationale: Order parameters are laid out as a numbered wizard (1..6) ending in a total and 'add to cart', so pricing inputs and checkout live on the same panel.

nodes.label: Preflight Panel (badge + messages)
nodes.rationale: Preflight results are shown inline in the order docker and repeated in the preview modal, so the check follows the order rather than the canvas.

nodes.label: Back-Side Lock for One-Sided Printing (4+0)
nodes.rationale: When the order is single-sided (4+0) the back side is not editable; it is blocked with an overlay and a shortcut button that switches the order to 4+4.

nodes.label: Print PDF 1.4 Export (curves + crop marks)
nodes.rationale: Text is exported as outlined curves and the PDF carries crop marks, so the print shop does not need the fonts and gets trimmed-page geometry.

nodes.label: Price Calculation and Finishing Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Price is computed together with finishing compatibility checks, implying some finishing combinations are rejected rather than silently priced.

nodes.label: Single-Screen Workspace
nodes.rationale: Everything the user needs (canvas, order panel, preflight, 3D mockup, PDF generator) lives on one screen to avoid navigation between separate tools.

nodes.label: Inline 3D Mockup View (#inline3dMockupView)
nodes.rationale: Lamination glare, foil embossing, designer-paper texture and the latte-cup cone shape are preview-only effects and deliberately excluded from the print PDF.

nodes.label: Order Cart Modal (#cartModal)
nodes.rationale: Cart aggregates order lines and hands them to the print shop via a single checkout action.

nodes.label: Preview and PDF Generation Modal (#previewModal)
nodes.rationale: Final confirmation combines both sides, 3D mockup, order specification, total, technical control and the PDF download in one modal.
